verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says Guided Reviews "break diffs into focused sections with explainers on what changed and why," which matches the story almost word for word. Supporting docs show code review happening inside Linear, including diff rendering and iterating with Linear Agent. The evidence is a single short changelog line, though, and it never explicitly says the explainers are AI-generated. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how Guided Reviews work, explicit confirmation that the sectioning and explanations are AI-driven, independent or hands-on corroboration.
